Name: VividNpcs
Author: JayZhang88
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]VividNpcs 为星露谷物语的33位NPC添加了AI驱动的对话系统。通过LLM（大语言模型），每个NPC都拥有独特的个性、记忆和互动方式。你可以和威利聊钓鱼心得、听塞巴斯蒂安吐槽程序员生活、收到格斯亲手做的菜——所有对话都是实时生成的，不会重复。[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]VividNpcs adds AI-powered dialogue to 33 NPCs in Stardew Valley. Through LLM integration, each NPC gains a unique personality, memory, and interaction style. Talk fishing tips with Willy, hear Sebastian complain about programmer life, or receive a home-cooked meal from Gus — all conversations are generated in real-time and never repeat.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]1. 安装 [SMAPI](https://smapi.io/)（4.0或更高版本）
2. 下载并解压 VividNpcs 到游戏的 `Mods` 文件夹
3. 安装 [Generic Mod Config Menu](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098)（推荐，用于游戏内配置）
4. 启动游戏，进入存档
5. 打开 GMCM（选项 → 模组配置 → VividNpcs），填入你的 LLM API 信息
6. 走到任意NPC附近，按下快捷键（默认F9）开始对话 [/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]1. Install [SMAPI](https://smapi.io/) (4.0 or later)
2. Download and extract VividNpcs into your game's `Mods` folder
3. Install [Generic Mod Config Menu](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098) (recommended, for in-game configuration)
4. Launch the game and load a save
5. Open GMCM (Options → Mod Config → VividNpcs) and enter your LLM API credentials
6. Walk up to any NPC and press the chat hotkey (default: F9) to start a conversation[/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]**AI对话系统**
- 与附近NPC自由对话，回复根据角色性格实时生成
- 支持中文和英文自动识别
- NPC会根据好感度、时间、天气、当前位置调整对话内容[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]**AI Dialogue System**
- Free-form conversations with nearby NPCs, replies generated in real-time based on character personality
- Auto-detects Chinese and English
- NPCs adjust dialogue based on friendship level, time of day, weather, and current location[/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]- Stardew Valley 1.6+
- SMAPI 4.0+
- 一个LLM API（OpenAI / Ollama / MIMO / 其他兼容API）
- Generic Mod Config Menu（推荐，用于游戏内配置）[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]- Stardew Valley 1.6+
- SMAPI 4.0+
- An LLM API (OpenAI / Ollama / MIMO / any compatible API)
- Generic Mod Config Menu (recommended, for in-game configuration)[/color]
